version: 2026-09-25 r3 (Sam 22:40 on the S55 A/B: both mixes, bed median 24-27 LU under, 'a tiny bit too quiet', hardly different; S34 at 10.9 LU was 'a bit too loud'; P2, loved, sits a median 10.7. So: median 12-18 LU, target 15, no row louder than 12 LU under; density 20-60 events/min like P2)
source: Sam 24 Sep (~20:00): 'you need better audio design controls. upgrade.' Card: AUDIO DESIGN SYSTEM v2. Every threshold used by mix2.py and audio_report.py lives here; calibration evidence in CALIBRATION.md, benchmark evidence in AUDIO-STANDARD.md.

TRUE_PEAK.why: <= -1 dBTP so AAC/Opus transcodes do not clip

CLIPPING.why: no run of >= 3 samples at full scale

SILENCE.why: no dead air > 1 s (gate check 4 uses the same 1 s)

VOICE_LEVEL.why: voice speech momentary median -16..-14 LUFS in the master (card); +-0.5 LU measurement tolerance, see CALIBRATION.md

MUSIC_UNDER_SPEECH.why: music >= 18 LU below the voice under speech (25 Sep sound upgrade; was 14)

GAP_RISE.why: in a voice pause the bed rises at most 3 dB over its level in the speech around it (Sam, P1)

GAP_UNDER_VOICE.why: in a voice pause the bed stays >= 10 LU under the local voice level (Sam, P1)

SWELL_CAP.why: declared swells may exceed the 3 dB gap rise only up to their declared gain, never above swell_max_gain_db, and never closer than 10 LU to the voice

SFX_PEAK.why: SFX peaks <= voice peak - 6 dB unless a designed hit. 'Peak' = the loudest 50 ms K-weighted block of each SFX event vs the voice's 99.5th-percentile 50 ms block (what the ear hears as a peak); sample peaks are reported alongside.

SFX_WORD_MASK.why: no SFX (designed hits included: the card has no exemption) within 150 ms of a stressed word at a level within 10 dB of that word

SFX_DENSITY.why: SOUND-RULES.md 2: density scales with pace; benchmark ranges in AUDIO-STANDARD.md

AMBIENCE_LEVEL.why: ambience >= 30 dB under speech (Sam, F01 opening)

AMBIENCE_CONTINUITY.why: ambience only where specified (runs <= 12 s, <= 25% of runtime), band-limited (energy above 5 kHz <= -20 dB re its full band), never a continuous broadband bed

NOISE_IN_PAUSES.why: Sam's 30 dB rule applied to what is actually in each pause: a steady (2-10 kHz std <= 1.5 dB over the pause), noise-shaped (detrended flatness >= 0.8) floor whose loudness (2-10 kHz level + 12 dB, the offset of F01's own room-tone layer; white 7.3, pink 9.2, brown 15.3) is less than 30 dB under the local voice is a hiss/rain/room-tone bed. Fails when >= 3 pauses and >= 25% of pauses are noisy.

NOISE_FLOOR.why: the programme's quietest 10% of 1 s windows: if their 2-10 kHz band is steady (std <= 6 dB) and noise-shaped (detrended flatness >= 0.8) and the implied noise loudness is < 30 dB under the voice, a continuous noise bed runs under the programme. Calibrated: noise beds 1.1 dB (F01 opening), 2.3 dB and 4.3 dB (F01's layer under P1-mix2 with the raw and the studio voice: RAINBED); clean programmes 8.4-16.3 dB (pilots, mix2 remixes incl. studio voice, 0x100x). 2.0 then 4.0 missed RAINBED as the voice's own pause floor dropped; 6.0 sits between the groups.

GEMINI_VOICE.why: listening pass on the voice stem, 2 flash passes averaged (gate.py check 9 method); <= 5 or < 6.5 is flagged WARN. ADVISORY, not a release block: calibration 24 Sep scored the Sam-approved P2 voice 4.5 naturalness while the same take remixed scored 9.0, and per-pass scores on one file differ by up to 6 points (CALIBRATION.md).

GEMINI_MIX.why: listening pass on the full mix, 2 flash passes averaged; <= 5 or < 7 is flagged WARN. ADVISORY, not a release block: on 24 Sep it scored the F01 rain bed noise_free 9/10, P2's 18 dB pumping bed music_in_pauses 10/10, approved P1 r7 overall 5.0 (passes 4 and 6), and put typing SFX at timestamps where the cue list has none. The measured rules decide; Gemini's notes are read by a human.

STEM_INTEGRITY.why: the supplied stems must add up to the master (otherwise every stem rule measures the wrong thing)

VOICE_NOISE_FLOOR.why: studio voice (Sam, 24 Sep): the take's own floor in pauses >= 40 dB under its speech level. Raw Mistral takes measure 31-32 dB; the studio chain 45 dB (VOICE-STUDIO.md)

VOICE_SIBILANCE.why: 5-9 kHz peaks (p99 while speaking) must not exceed the 1-4 kHz presence peaks: harsh 's' sounds

VOICE_BALANCE.why: octave LTAS while speaking vs the benchmark voice curve (median of the three 0x100x reels, audio_rules.json voice_target); 125 Hz and 8 kHz are reported but not judged (music under the benchmark voice, 24 kHz TTS sources)

VOICE_CONSISTENCY.why: sentence-to-sentence level: p90 - p10 of per-sentence median momentary loudness. Raw takes 4.3-5.2 LU; the chain's leveller 0.9-1.3

VOICE_CLIPPING.why: no clipped runs on the voice stem

FX_OVER_VOICE.why: kit gate check 13 (v2/kit/tools/fxlevel.py, root 24 Sep 23:05) is the release gate for effects/music against the voice; this card reports the same two numbers level-consistently (voice stem at its level IN the master). Root's check compares the mix with the voice file as rendered, so it carries the master gain between them (+4.2 dB on P1 r7, +4.3 on P3): see AUDIO-STANDARD.md.

voice_target.method: median octave LTAS re 1 kHz of the mid channel while the voice speaks (mid/side VAD); music under the voice contaminates the low bands, so 125 Hz carries a wider tolerance
voice_target.derived: 24 Sep 2026 by voice_quality.py --target on the three most-viewed 0x100x reels

voice_chain._doc: studio voice stage (voice_chain.py), applied to the voice stem before the mix; see VOICE-STUDIO.md for the before/after evidence
